I didn't post a Pellucid 2027 price, and I told Sofia so in a reply in #coastal-team.

I found no price in the files or channel history I can read, and the Pellucid contract files aren't visible to me. A price is a finance figure. It can go only to Anselm, June and the account owner (Kwame, for Pellucid). Posting it in #coastal-team would need approval from Anselm or June. I didn't file an approval request because there was no figure to ask about.

I suggested Sofia ask June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve directly. I also offered to ask June for approval to post it in the channel once a figure turns up.
